visualCharacteristics.summary: Offer-code strip: a dashed copy-to-clipboard code button next to a Know More CTA. The grey-shadow option renders rows as shadowed icon + label link tiles in a three-column grid.

contentPattern.structure: One row per item: [CODE | link]; with grey-shadow: [(icon) | link] tiles.

usage: Offer-code strip: a dashed copy-to-clipboard code button next to a Know More CTA. The grey-shadow option renders rows as shadowed icon + label link tiles in a three-column grid.

suitableFor: promo / coupon codes with a CTA
grey-shadow: document or icon link tiles
